# Migration audit

The entire supplied research catalogue was reviewed on 2026-10-30, through its final GitHub editorial backlog. The original catalogue, all twelve craft expansions, and the later deconstruction/repair/upgrade section were read. This public audit preserves the import ledger and original tutorial links. Private workspace addresses are intentionally omitted. Inherited research is not an authority for present access claims.

All **131 resource rows** were imported into **124 unique records**. The seven “first stops” repeat table resources and add no unique links. Non-resource idea tables and future research directions were not fabricated into resources. No resource row was silently dropped.

## Merges

- [Carving Junkies](catalogue-details.md#carving-junkies) — source rows 4, 82. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.
- [CigarBoxGuitars.com](catalogue-details.md#cigarboxguitars-com) — source rows 64, 106. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.
- [Exploratorium — Cardboard Automata](catalogue-details.md#exploratorium-cardboard-automata) — source rows 19, 103. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.
- [Jo &amp; Co — Weave Your First Basket](catalogue-details.md#jo-co-weave-your-first-basket) — source rows 62, 73. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.
- [Park Tool — Repair Help](catalogue-details.md#park-tool-repair-help) — source rows 58, 125. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.
- [Whittling Library](catalogue-details.md#whittling-library) — source rows 5, 81. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.
- [Wood &amp; Shop — Tool Sharpening and Refurbishing](catalogue-details.md#wood-shop-tool-sharpening-and-refurbishing) — source rows 77, 116. All titles, URLs, setup and section references retained.

The CigarBoxGuitars root and `/how-to-build` were treated as one archive, with both URLs preserved. Distinct tutorials from one creator remain separate records.

## Corrections and unresolved scope

- [Exploratorium — Cardboard Automata](catalogue-details.md#exploratorium-cardboard-automata) — current publisher URL: https://www.exploratorium.edu/tinkering/projects/cardboard-automata; original retained.

Cornell mechanisms, Make it Yourself, Class Central, Cambridge plant-dye background, Restarters principles and the old-bike overview are retained as references rather than standalone project recommendations. Homepage links, kit dependence, paid/free mixtures and undemonstrated course claims stay flagged for review. No paid-only finding is hidden by relabeling it free.
